verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh ships its own AI agents (Customer Screening and Transaction Monitoring), so asking whether users can plug in external MCP servers is a fair question here. Nothing in the evidence shows it can act as an MCP client or let users register MCP servers. The llms.txt index, webhooks and OpenAPI schema are adjacent features that let outside tools reach Mesh, not ways for Mesh to call MCP tools, and the Starter Plan agent configurations are documented as non-customizable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
